Card Q&A.a: No. The effect can only be activated if the Digimon itself has 2 or more colors.
Card Q&A.q: This card has an effect that reads, “When one of your Digimon with 2 or more colors attacks”―does this include the colors of the attacking Digimon’s digivolution cards?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a red Digimon in play, gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon with 2 or more colors attacks, you may suspend this Tamer to delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
